- Windows 11: a new File Explorer (tab, toolbar, address bar, command bar, Quick access, see-through panels), a tray with connection, sound and battery that opens the quick settings, and a new Start menu (a tall four-column panel upright, a wide six-column one turned).
- Windows 7 and 11 windows: the title bar and frame are more see-through over the blurred desktop.
- Windows Media Player look: a new WMP 12 player (real artist and cover, glossy play button, Show list, volume, Library of albums); the old WMP 7 stays as a setting.
- Windows desktops: apps can open as full-screen apps (a setting; a long press on a window's taskbar button does it for one window); icons can be placed anywhere (snap to grid off); a slide on the empty desktop picks icons.
- File windows: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and LibreOffice documents show their text; the Pictures place opens a gallery window.
- Keyboard: the suggestion bar is never empty and stays on in terminal apps; an upright HEIC photo in the clipboard stays upright.
- Music player: a blur strength setting for the Blended look (the lyrics follow it), a separate lock screen lyrics size, an optional second row of buttons.
- Game Hub: the grouped built-in games have a cover with twine; the disc that flies into the console is smaller.
- Library (e-book): neutral greys instead of a brown tint.
- Weather map: a short, small place label ("Tekirdağ, Türkiye").
